2607.01039.title: EchoRisk: A Multicentre Echocardiography Dataset and Benchmark for Cardio-Oncology
2607.01039.paper_summary: Therapy-induced cardiotoxicity is the leading non-oncological cause of treatment interruption in breast cancer patients, yet early, automated risk stratification from routine cardiac imaging remains an unsolved problem. We present EchoRisk, the first curated, multicentre, longitudinal echocardiography dataset with explicit cardiotoxicity labels, released as the primary technical reference for the EchoRisk-MICCAI 2026 challenge. The dataset comprises 422 patients enrolled in the EU-funded CARDIOCARE prospective study across five European sites, yielding 2,159 echocardiography videos across 1,123 clinical exams acquired at up to five longitudinal timepoints, alongside a dedicated cohort of 280 patients with baseline imaging for early cardiotoxicity prediction. Three clinically grounded tasks are defined: automated estimation of left ventricular ejection fraction from cine video (Task 1), classification of LV dysfunction from longitudinal imaging (Task 2), and early prediction of therapy-induced cardiotoxicity from pre-therapy baseline echocardiography alone (Task 3). For each task we specify the evaluation protocol, primary and secondary metrics, and ranking procedure. We establish baseline performance using an R(2+1)D video backbone with LSTM aggregation trained from Kinetics-400 pretrained weights, demonstrating strong discriminative performance for cardiac functional assessment and LV dysfunction classification, while early cardiotoxicity prediction from a single pre-therapy video remains a significant open problem for the community. The dataset, evaluation code, and baseline implementations are publicly available to serve as a benchmark for further collaboration, comparison, and the creation of task-specific architectures in cardio-oncology.
2607.01039.paper_summary_zh: 治療引起的心臟毒性是乳腺癌患者中治療中斷的主要非腫瘤原因，但從常規心臟影像學中進行早期自動風險分層仍然是一個未解決的問題。<lb/>我們提出了EchoRisk，這是第一個經過策劃的多中心縱向超聲心動圖數據集，具有明確的心臟毒性標籤，作為EchoRisk-MICCAI 2026挑戰的主要技術參考。<lb/>該數據集包括422名參加歐盟資助的CARDIOCARE前瞻性研究的患者，來自五個歐洲地點，共產生2,159段超聲心動圖視頻，涵蓋1,123次臨床檢查，並在多達五個縱向時間點獲得，還有一個專門的280名患者的隊列，進行基線影像學以預測早期心臟毒性。<lb/>定義了三個臨床基礎的任務：從電影視頻自動估計左心室射血分數（任務1）、從縱向影像學分類左心室功能障礙（任務2），以及僅從治療前基線超聲心動圖早期預測治療引起的心臟毒性（任務3）。<lb/>對於每個任務，我們指定了評估協議、主要和次要指標以及排名程序。<lb/>我們使用R(2+1)D視頻骨幹與LSTM聚合建立基準性能，該骨幹從Kinetics-400預訓練權重進行訓練，顯示出對心臟功能評估和左心室功能障礙分類的強大區分性能，而僅從單個治療前視頻進行早期心臟毒性預測仍然是社區中的一個重要開放問題。<lb/>該數據集、評估代碼和基準實現公開可用，以作為進一步合作、比較和在心臟腫瘤學中創建特定任務架構的基準。
